versions.subject: Added rule for RClone usage for exfiltration
versions.detection:
selection:
    Description: 'Rsync for cloud storage'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--config '
        - '--no-check-certificate '
        - ' copy '
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: Description="Rsync for cloud storage" OR (CommandLine="*--config *" CommandLine="*--no-check-certificate *" CommandLine="* copy *")

versions.subject: Update sysmon_rclone_execution.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    Description: 'Rsync for cloud storage'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--config '
        - '--no-check-certificate '
        - ' copy '
selection3:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\rclone.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'mega'
        - 'pcloud'
        - 'ftp'
        - '--progress'
        - '--ignore-existing'
        - '--auto-confirm'
        - '--transfers'
        - '--multi-thread-streams'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: Description="Rsync for cloud storage" OR (CommandLine="*--config *" CommandLine="*--no-check-certificate *" CommandLine="* copy *") OR (Image="*\\rclone.exe" CommandLine IN ("*mega*", "*pcloud*", "*ftp*", "*--progress*", "*--ignore-existing*", "*--auto-confirm*", "*--transfers*", "*--multi-thread-streams*"))
